## ⚡ Open Source Pull Request Template

### Description
Provide a summary of the changes you have introduced, detailing the problem solved and the implementation details.

---

### Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug Fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New Feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🛠️ Refactoring / Performance Optimization (code cleanup)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation Update (README, architecture, etc.)

---

### 🎨 Visual & Design Checklist (for UI Changes)
- [ ] Conforms to the project's **Neo-Brutalist** style (thick black borders, flat shadows).
- [ ] Colors match the CSS variables theme (`--yellow`, `--pink`, `--lime`, `--teal`, `--coral`).
- [ ] Responsive and checked on mobile devices.

---

### 🧪 Verification Checklist
- [ ] I have ran the local linting script cleanly: `npm run lint`
- [ ] Code is formatted cleanly with Prettier: `npm run check-format`
- [ ] All changes have been tested locally on browser (PWA) / Capacitor (Android).
